label: Deflecting Swat in, Generous Gift out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Swat is free with Arabella out and redirects a removal spell aimed at her or any targeted spell or ability. Gift was the fifth catch-all removal spell. Removal 7 -> 6, Protection 5 -> 6.

label: Krenko, Mob Boss in, Assemble the Legion out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin, Legion Warboss and Ainok Strike Leader make Goblins, so his {T} grows the board exponentially with a doubler out. Assemble the Legion is a 5-mana enchantment that starts slow. Average MV 2.91 -> 2.89.

label: Soul Warden in, Resplendent Angel out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Soul Warden is a 1/1 that counts for Arabella and gains a life for every creature entering, which feeds Dawn of Hope and Ocelot Pride. The Angel's own body is power 3, it does nothing the turn it lands unless you gained 5, and its pump costs 6.

label: Endless Foot Assault in, Loyal Apprentice out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Three tapped and attacking Ninjas per attack (one per opponent), more with squad copies at {1}{W} each, and Windcrag doubles each copy. Apprentice made one Thopter a combat.

label: Elspeth, Storm Slayer in, Elspeth, Sun's Champion out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Storm Slayer doubles every token source in the deck, costs 5 instead of 6, and her -3 is clean removal. Sun's Champion's -3 kills the deck's own Adeline, Mondrak and Ojer Taq. Storm Slayer's 0 (counters) is optional.

label: Worf in, Grand Crescendo out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Whenever Worf attacks, a tapped and attacking 1/1 flying Faerie for each attacking non-Faerie creature, all power 1; Windcrag Siege doubles the trigger. Order it after the attack-time token makers and before Arabella. Moogles' Valor and Flawless Maneuver still give indestructible. Worf is power 5, so the deck's own Dusk // Dawn and Battle of Bywater kill it.

label: Raph & Leo in, Ragged Playmate out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. An extra combat every turn on a power-2 body: on the first attack, untap Arabella (and one more attacker) and she attacks again, so her triggers fire again. Arabella needs no evasion, because her trigger fires on attack.

label: General Kreat in, Oketra's Monument out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Pings each opponent for every other creature entering, makes an attacking Goblin when Goblins attack (feeds Krenko, Mob Boss), and is power 2, so it counts for Arabella and survives the deck's own wipes. Ramp 9 -> 8.

label: Witty Roastmaster in, Esper Sentinel out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call, alongside Raid Bombardment. Pings each opponent for every other creature entering, attack tokens included. Esper only drew when an opponent wouldn't pay {1}. Draw 9 -> 8. Witty is power 3: it doesn't count for X and dies to the deck's own Dusk // Dawn.

label: Iroas in, Aggravated Assault out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Iroas gives your creatures menace and prevents all damage to your attacking creatures, so the board can attack every turn without losing tokens, on an indestructible enchantment. Aggravated Assault cost 5 per extra combat; Aurelia, Combat Celebrant and Raph & Leo still give extra combats.

label: Tempt with Vengeance in, a Plains out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call, keeping Secure the Wastes too. X hasty 1/1s that can attack the turn they arrive. Lands 34 -> 33 at a 2.86 average MV: four lands by turn 4 on the play goes from 47.0% to 44.1%.

label: Dolmen Gate in, The Battle of Bywater out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call. Dolmen Gate prevents all combat damage to attacking creatures, a second copy of Iroas's job, so the board can attack every turn without shrinking next turn's X. Bywater would now destroy most of the deck's own payoffs (Worf, Witty Roastmaster, Krenko Mob Boss, Myrel, Mondrak, Ojer Taq, Kirol, Aurelia, Combat Celebrant, Adeline). Dusk // Dawn and Winds of Abandon's overload remain as one-sided wipes.

label: Mithril Coat in, Grand Abolisher out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call to cut Grand Abolisher or Voice of Victory; Abolisher picked because Myrel already stops opponents' spells and abilities on your turn and Voice stops spells, so it was the only one of the three doing nothing else. Mithril Coat has flash, attaches to Arabella as it enters and gives her indestructible, in response to a destroy effect. It doesn't stop exile.

label: Swiftfoot Boots in, Molten Gatekeeper out
author: user
rationale: Pilot's call (Gatekeeper kept in the sideboard). Boots gives Arabella hexproof and haste, so she attacks the turn she is recast. Gatekeeper was the sixth per-entry pinger and does what Agate Instigator does for one more mana.
